high_level_description: This image depicts the entrance to the Our Lady of Immaculate Conception Cathedral, also known as the La Cathédrale de Notre Dame de l'Immaculée Conception. The cathedral is a prominent white building with classical architectural features, including columns, a pediment, and a statue of the Virgin Mary above the main entrance. The entrance is framed by two large pillars with ornate tops, and there is a decorative wrought iron gate above the pillars.
